respuesta.pregunta: In 2p-revenue-optimizer-api 0.2.2, how are rule_row records tied back to their rule_header? And what values can the type column of rule_header take, and what does each one mean?
respuesta.respuesta: Each rule_row record points to its rule through the `rule_id` column. It is a `bigint`, it is Not null, and it is a foreign key that `REFERENCES rule_header(id)` [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/0.2.2/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_row.md:L10-L10]. On the rule_header side, `id` is a `bigint`, Not null, auto-increment primary key [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/0.2.2/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_header.md:L9-L9]. The documentation for 0.2.2 doesn't cover the `type` column of rule_header. It doesn't describe what the column means, it doesn't list the values it can take, and it doesn't explain what any value means. I can't tell you those values.
